2607.12946.title: ViHoRec: A Quality-Controlled Vietnamese Hotel Recommendation Dataset and Cold-Start Benchmark
2607.12946.paper_summary: Recommender-system research for Vietnamese remains limited by the absence of a public, well-documented hotel interaction resource. Building such a resource is challenging for three reasons: cross-platform hotel names must be reconciled before interactions are comparable; quality must be audited with reproducible metrics rather than ad hoc cleaning; and public release must preserve privacy while remaining benchmarkable under realistic cold-start conditions. We introduce ViHoRec, a quality-controlled Vietnamese hotel recommendation dataset of 18{,}267 interactions between 6{,}832 users and 560 hotels, crawled from Booking.com, Traveloka, and Ivivu. Our contributions are: (i) a reproducible construction pipeline with cross-platform entity resolution and quantitative quality control; (ii) a privacy-preserving release with HMAC pseudonyms; and (iii) a public cold-start benchmark with temporal leave-last-one-out split, data-centric ablations, and dependency-free baselines. On the public split, learned models degrade sharply for users with short histories (BPR-MF Recall@10: 0.065 vs. 0.120), while UserKNN remains strongest overall, establishing ViHoRec as a sparse, cold-start-dominated testbed for low-resource recommendation. All data are publicly available at https://github.com/MinhNguyenDS/ViHoRec.
2607.12946.paper_summary_zh: 越南的推薦系統研究受到缺乏公共且文檔完善的酒店互動資源的限制。建立這樣的資源面臨三個挑戰：跨平台的酒店名稱必須在互動之前進行調和，以便互動可比較；質量必須用可重複的指標進行審核，而不是臨時清理；公共發布必須在保持隱私的同時，仍然能在現實的冷啟動條件下進行基準測試。我們介紹了 ViHoRec，這是一個經過質量控制的越南酒店推薦數據集，包含 18,267 次互動，涉及 6,832 位用戶和 560 家酒店，數據來源於 Booking.com、Traveloka 和 Ivivu。我們的貢獻包括：（i）一個可重複的建構流程，具備跨平台實體解析和定量質量控制；（ii）一個保護隱私的發布，使用 HMAC 偽名；以及（iii）一個公共的冷啟動基準，具備時間性最後一個留出分割、數據中心的消融實驗和無依賴基準。在公共分割上，對於歷史較短的用戶，學習模型的性能急劇下降（BPR-MF Recall@10: 0.065 對比 0.120），而 UserKNN 整體表現最強，確立了 ViHoRec 作為一個稀疏、以冷啟動為主的低資源推薦測試平台。所有數據均可在 https://github.com/MinhNguyenDS/ViHoRec 上公開獲取。
2607.12946.author: Minh Hoang Nguyen et.al.
